title: General hero (scripted diagnostic): web page -> analysis -> chart
description: DIAGNOSTIC fixture, not a model run: a scripted driver for the web-analysis profile. It opens the hosted fixture page (regional-sales.html in this directory, served at the URL below; create the task with egressAllow ["airlock-fixtures.example.com"] or edit the URL to where you host it), observes it, stores a screenshot, saves the page text as inputs/regions.csv, writes and runs the labelled analysis.py, and submits outputs/summary.json + outputs/chart.png. Every model event is labelled scripted.

turns.text: Capturing the page as evidence and handing its text to the code sandbox.
Submitting the summary, the chart and the source.

args.summary: Scripted diagnostic: the region with the lowest revenue/target ratio on the fixture page, with a chart.
